objective: Produce clinically faithful and tonally aligned patient letters via AI drafting + clinician finalization, validated by patient response

stages.name: Resonance (Self)
stages.notes: Two-channel calibration: clinician fatigue/load + agent retrieval/confidence state; explicit handoff contract recorded

stages.name: Access Point
stages.notes: Selected patient-context fit anchor with clinical fidelity as hard invariant

stages.name: Assembly
stages.notes: Consent-bounded patient record + guideline excerpts; provenance per source

stages.name: Orientation
stages.notes: Joint orientation map with explicitly marked human-only context cues

stages.name: Transition
stages.notes: Drafting gated on evidence anchors, human-only cues present, explicit tone constraints

stages.name: Movement
stages.notes: AI dropped a hedged caveat; intercepted and rolled back to stage 03 to mark caveat non-negotiable

stages.name: Trajectory
stages.notes: Tonal-edit rate decreasing; caveat-removal incidents trending to zero after gate

stages.name: Resonance (World)
stages.notes: Patient response rate up; one residual comprehension gap surfaced via escalation route

next_cycle_inputs: Treat internal review-pass rate as process metric, not orientation evidence
